messages:
Stefan L: Heads-up — onboarding call with GlobalBank tomorrow. They want Python SDK streaming + function/tool calls for billing events, and strict short-lived creds via OIDC. Any immediate gotchas?
Mira P: Backend->backend minting ephemeral keys is the safest. For browser flows do OIDC code exchange -> backend -> mint ephemeral key. Avoid embedding long-lived keys client-side.
Alex J: Python snippet we've used in presales:
```py
from redwood import Client
EPHEMERAL = get_ephemeral_token()
client = Client(stream_url='https://inference.redwood.ai/sse', token=EPHEMERAL)
with client.stream() as s:
    s.send_json({
        "type": "tool_call",
        "tool": "invoice.create",
        "args": {"customer_id": "GB-001", "amount": 1200.00, "currency": "USD"}
    })
```
Kofi A: For structured outputs, set `structured_response: true` and use the func-json envelope. Minimal example payload: 
```json
{ "type": "response", "schema": "invoice_v1", "data": { "id": "inv_1001", "total": 1200.00, "lines": [{"desc":"service","amt":1200.00}] } }
```
Mira P: Security Qs they always ask: encryption at rest, KMS options, retention windows, and PII handling. Short answers: AES-256 at rest, customer-managed KMS supported, configurable retention (default 30d), and recommend Private (VPC/on-prem) for regulated workloads. I'll draft precise wording for their questionnaire.
Stefan L: They also want SLA for streaming tails and whether messages persist on our infra.
Mira P: We persist request/response logs for audit by default (configurable). We can redact or opt-out per contract. SLA: hosted has documented latency/uptime targets; Dedicated/Private can include stricter SLAs.
Alex J: Latency tuning tips for realtime billing flows: enable prefix caching, disable per-connection automatic batching (`batching: 'off'`), and pin to lower-sequence-length model variants. Example runtime hints: `runtime_hints={"cachePrefixes":True, "batching":"off"}`.
security-bot: Security questionnaire uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/sec/GB-questionnaire-2026.pdf :file_folder:
oncall-sre: FYI @Stefan added SRE contact for the POC (oncall-sre). We'll be on standby during the call.
Kofi A: Pricing: hosted -> token/streaming + per-minute stream compute; Dedicated -> reserved pool. I'll DM a rough back-of-envelope for 500 concurrent sessions (depends on avg tokens/sec).
Mira P: Runbook checklist I plan to include: auth flow diagrams, SDK snippets (py/js), expected telemetry to collect (latency p50/p95, tokens/s, error rates), security answers, and escalation contacts. Can deliver by EOD.
Stefan L: Great. Action items: @Mira produce runbook, @Alex publish SDK sample repo, @Kofi prepare security answers for questionnaire. Thanks all :thumbsup:
security-bot: Note — Private deployment lead time estimate: 3-6 weeks depending on region and legal review.
Stefan L: Perfect. I'll summarize before the call and send the calendar invite.
